submitted.rationale: XRD shows a Sb-rich phase (main peak Q≈1.878) at indices 14 and 24, and a Pb-rich phase (Q≈2.039) that dominates at index 4. EQE went up toward the Pb-rich side: 0.0040% at index 19, 0.0047% at index 9 and 0.0072% at index 5, which sits in the two-phase region near the Pb-rich phase. Index 5 has the highest measured EQE.
